reason: The simulation cannot run due to missing core methods (run, initialize completion, evaluate). These are critical blockers but are straightforward to implement given the existing modular design. Another iteration can restore end-to-end functionality, enable evaluation, and address scaling issues, yielding significant improvement before the 3-iteration limit.

specific_areas: Complete Simulation.initialize: finalize state arrays, build or fallback-generate network, precompute neighbor indices, instantiate RetailMarket, derive initial states from day 0 where available.
Implement Simulation.run daily loop handling policy/media, exposure, information diffusion, retail purchases, household_share computation, mask adoption, and aggregation.
Implement Simulation.evaluate: compute RMSE/MAE on calibration window (days 0–29), plus peak, time-to-50%, final adoption (day 39), and subgroup Gini.
Clip ExposureCalculator peer_mask_fraction per layer to [0,1] after weighting to prevent inflated log-odds.
Ensure household_share is computed from the family layer and passed to MaskAdoptionDecision.
Add network fallback (small-world) when social_network.json is missing/empty; then build neighbors and precompute indices.
Verify RetailMarket.step return handling and persist updated budgets/inventory.
Add a smoke test path: run N=1,000 for 5 days to ensure no runtime errors and no NaN/Inf in outputs.
Align policy start day (Day 10) and validation window (days 30–39) with evaluation outputs.
